name: humor-mcp

tools.name: search_humor
tools.description: Full-text search the humor corpus. Returns lines with their credit attached. Filter by source pack, kind or minimum human score.

query.description: words to search for; empty = browse by score

source.description: restrict to one pack id — naming a pack overrides both gates below

kind.description: joke / pun / candidate / slate_winner / eval / utterance / word

min_score.description: only lines a human scored at least this highly

whole_lines.description: drop transcript offcuts that start or stop mid-sentence; heuristic, and strict about a final full stop

include_restricted.description: include packs whose LICENCE bars redistribution (local reference only)

include_hidden.description: include packs the corpus owner marked off-rubric — their licence is fine, they were judged unrepresentative

tools.name: top_rated
tools.description: The highest human-rated lines in the corpus. Single-word lexicon entries use a different scale and are excluded unless kind='word'.
